The recurrence is X_{n+1} = 1103515245 * X_n + 12345 mod 2^31. Because 1103515245 = 3 * 367838415 and 12345 = 3 * 4115, we have X_{n+1} mod 3 = (3*367838415*X_n + 3*4115) mod 3 = 0. Thus X_n mod 3 = 0 for all n >= 1. This restricts X_n mod 6 to values {0, 3}. Because X_0 = 42 is also divisible by 3, even X_0 mod 6 is in {0, 3}. The face map die_n = 1 + (X_n mod 6) can therefore only output faces {1, 4} after the first draw, so the distribution over six faces cannot be fair.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
